v1.0.0.notes: Baseline. Tagged from pre-existing nanoclaw-agent:latest at start of canary-channels work.

v1.1.0.notes: Upgrade from v1.0.0. SDK 0.2.76 → 0.3.147. CLI pinned to 2.1.147 (was unpinned). Breaking changes: MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0 set (0.3.142 background MCP), session_id made optional in SDKUserMessage (0.2.86), @anthropic-ai/sdk added as explicit dep (0.3.143 peerDeps change). TodoWrite kept alongside Task tools for transition.

v1.2.0.notes: Upgrade from v1.1.0. Same SDK (0.3.147) and CLI (2.1.147). Adds task management isolation and tools: required `description` field on schedule_task, request/response IPC pattern (.req.json/.resp.json), reworked list_tasks (own-group + description + 50-char preview), new get_task tool, new search_tasks tool, update_task accepts description, removed snapshot writes (current_tasks.json), removed isMain cross-group privilege for read/mutation tools. Wire-protocol compatibility: new host is fully backward-compatible with v1.0.0/v1.1.0 containers for existing tools; old containers' list_tasks returns empty (no snapshot) — intentional. Branch: feat/task-management-isolation-and-tools.

v1.21.0.notes: Security hardening batch. Skills default flipped to none (was: all). Bash excluded from default allowedTools when approvalMode active. WebSearch/WebFetch excluded from defaults (use nanoclaw-web-search MCP). register_group and delegate_to_group hidden from non-main groups at MCP server registration level (double-gated). Branch: feat/container-security-hardening.

v1.22.0.notes: Telegram multi-bot support. Per-group telegramBot field in containerConfig routes outbound replies to a named bot instance (TELEGRAM_{NAME}_BOT_TOKEN in secrets.env). Default bot used when field absent.

v1.23.0.notes: MCP tool visibility hardening. get_registered_groups gated to main-only (was: all groups). capabilities skill rewritten to remove hardcoded tool/MCP lists — now uses runtime introspection (env vars, filesystem, MCP context). No SDK or CLI changes.
